notes.title: The Isles of Krom – First Playtest Wrap-Up
notes.notes:
The first Isles of Krom playtest will officially come to a close by March 31st — and we want to extend a massive [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who joined us on this early journey! 🙌

Over [b]+400 players[/b] explored the Isles, battled creatures, uncovered secrets, and gave us incredible energy and insight. You also helped push us past [b]1,100 wishlists[/b] — which means the world to our small team.

We’re now shifting gears and focusing on the [b]next big milestones[/b], including preparing for a [b]second playtest this summer[/b] ☀️. We’ll be sharing more details about what’s coming soon — new features, improvements, and surprises.

In the meantime, we’d love to [b]hear your thoughts![/b] Your feedback is a huge part of shaping the game. If you played the playtest, please take a few minutes to fill out our  Google Feedback Form (length 5min)

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeJwGgpL7aJoY-Ch45sNlYdRTOXQ-rwTBNpNKgJnIRrQT1qSg/viewform?usp=dialog 
Thanks again for being part of this adventure. 

Team Floppy Goat 💾🐐

notes.title: Playtest 1 Feedback Update 1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Based on your extremely valuable feedback, we're excited to bring you a new update packed with improvements and fixes.

Check out what's new:
[b]Combat Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spearman Combat Overhaul:[/b] We've made significant changes to the Spearman's combat flow:
  [*] Added a short delay between attacks for a more strategic feel.
  [*] Increased the parry window for light attacks, making them more reliable.
[*] [b]Execution Polish:[/b]  Executions are now smoother and more satisfying:
  [*] Enemies will remain on the ground longer after being executed.
  [*] You'll be able to move sooner after performing an execution.
  [*] Execution input now has priority over melee combo input, making executions easier to trigger.
  [*] Bosses can now be front-executed when staggered!
[/list]
[b]Tutorial Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] We've integrated executions into the tutorial to help you master this crucial mechanic.
[*] The Character Sheet is now introduced in the tutorial.
[*] Adjusted the starting number of potions to 1, aligning with the initial state of your character.
[/list]
[b]Exploration Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Candles now illuminate your path in the darkest areas, creating a more immersive experience.
[*] We've added missing planks to catwalks for smoother navigation.
[/list]
[b]Options Menu Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] We've reworked the quality options for better clarity and control.
[*] Added new Graphics options: Chromatic Aberration and Motion Blur, allowing for further customization.
[/list]
[b]User Interface (UI) and Heads-Up Display (HUD) Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added icons to item and boon slots to clearly indicate when an item or boon is replacing an existing one.
[*] New HUD! We've redesigned the HUD with a focus on improving readability and making potion tracking easier. Let us know what you think!  We've also eliminated negative values from health and stamina bars.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where potions prevented stamina regeneration when consumed immediately after attacking.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Botanist wouldn't detect the player when standing too far away.
[/list]
[b]Performance Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Identified and optimized problematic assets that were causing performance issues.
[*] Implemented overall performance enhancements for a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]

We appreciate your continued support and feedback!  Let us know what you think of this update.

 Happy exploring!

notes.title: Isles Of Krom - Open Playtest
notes.notes:
💾🐐 Goats are at it today !

 🎉 We are thrilled to officially announce our upcoming game, Isles of Krom!

[previewyoutube=mutfz2CY4eM;full][/previewyoutube]

Isles of Krom blends the intricate combat of ⚔️Dark Souls⚔️  with the dynamic progression systems of 🔥Hades🔥, set in a captivating world of mystery and challenge.
🎮 Join our early open playtest and be among the first to explore the Isles ! Your feedback will help us refine and perfect the game.

Here’s how you can support us:
 1️-  Play the Playtest: Sign up here and share your thoughts!

🙏 Thank you for your support — it means the world to us! Together, let’s bring Isles of Krom to life. 

Don't forget to follow us on our other socials, it really helps us grow the community even more!
